name: Ollototae

attributes.attribute: site of the inscription to Ollototae

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ollototae is a goddess of Romanized British form. At Chester a written record names this multiple goddess. It is unclear whether she began as a Celtic goddess in Roman form or as a Roman version of the Celtic earth goddess.

okr.objective: Ollototae is a Romanized goddess known from an inscription at Chester.
key_results: Ollototae is a goddess of Romanized British form.
An inscription to her was found at Chester.
She may be a Celtic goddess in Roman form or a Roman earth goddess.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
